name: formal-project-42-demo
problem: Search near x=42, verify the distance non-negativity conjecture, retrieve a premise from a frozen Lean project, and replay the generated theorem with leanchecker --fresh.

metadata.purpose: v0.7 frozen Lake project, premise retrieval, and leanchecker --fresh smoke test
proof_assumptions: For every evaluated numeric candidate x, distance_to_42 is defined as abs(x - 42).

formal_contracts.conjecture_statement: Distance to 42 is always non-negative for evaluated candidates.

metadata.semantic_mapping: The executable predicate metrics.distance_to_42 >= 0 is represented as non-negativity of a natural-number distance d; the frozen project theorem FormalProject42.distance_nonnegative proves the same codomain invariant.
